title: Double Pendulum on a Cart
summary: A TU Vienna demo of a double inverted pendulum on a cart, using constrained feedforward and optimal feedback control for swing-up and point-to-point motion.
why: Cited as a harder real-world version of the pole-balancing problem and as proof that chaotic systems can be controlled.

quote.text: Triple!!! inverted pendulum balancing with a physical cart (2011), a much much much harder task
